policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: O introduces GPT-5.6-Cyber via Daybreak tiers
items.summary: O is rolling out a more cyber-permissive GPT-5.6 variant for vetted defenders under Daybreak Blue/Red, with different guardrails and capability targeting.

items.headline: O delays Astra release over cyber-safety findings
items.summary: O told Axios it cannot rule out “critical” cyber capabilities in Astra; the company is expanding safety testing and slowing development until stronger safeguards are in place.
